necessity.rationale: One explicit local policy has no independent context or authority boundary.
necessity.baseline: One host agent reading the library policy.

decisions.choice: One policy node with renew and staff-review outcomes
decisions.rationale: A reusable contract and bounded policy routing meet the goal without redundant roles.
decisions.rollback: Split only if an independent tool or approval boundary becomes necessary.

lifecycle.infra: Current host agent plus original local package controller; no library connector.
lifecycle.post: Read frozen inputs, apply policy, emit strict result and matching outcome.
lifecycle.after: Compare all frozen cases, reject stale replies, deliver package and preserve checkpoints.
